policy: Three independent IP assets with individual asking prices and defined transfer scopes. Digital Twin Core is priced for existing definition and acquisition documentation only; no implemented software is included.

assets.name: PLANTELOGIA Intelligence Platform

assets.pricingScope: Present first-party evidence-governed intelligence prototype, retained qualification, documentation and packaging. Production deployment, operational infrastructure, external evidence/data rights and future productisation are excluded.

assets.name: Digital Twin Core

assets.pricingScope: Existing first-party project definition and acquisition documentation only. No implemented software, validated digital-twin capability, protected technical invention or future development is included in this estimate.
